account.explainIndividual: One operator managing their own fields and decisions.
account.explainBusiness: A commercial operation with staff, roles and multiple farms.
account.explainFarmOrg: A cooperative, producer group or agricultural association.

team.title: Team & organization
team.subtitle: Collaborate across farms with roles, invitations and a shared activity history.
team.emptyDesc: Organizations group your farms, fields and teammates into one workspace with controlled access.
team.reason2: Roles from viewer to owner, enforced on the server
team.reason3: A shared activity history for every change
team.createDesc: You will be its owner. The name can be changed later.
team.membersDesc: People with access to this organization.
team.removeDesc: They will lose access to the farms and data of this organization immediately.
team.invitationsDesc: Invite teammates by email. The invite token is shown once — deliver it to the invitee yourself.
team.ownershipDesc: Hand the organization to another member. You become an organization admin.
team.transferDesc: Type the email of the new owner to confirm. This cannot be undone here.
team.rolesNote: The server enforces role permissions; this interface only shows what your role allows.

onboarding.title: Getting started
onboarding.subtitle: A short guided setup. Only the basics are required, and progress is saved when you leave.
onboarding.accountTypeDesc: This shapes defaults for roles and billing. You can change it later.
onboarding.orgDesc: Create a new organization, or join one with an invitation token.
onboarding.orgProfileDesc: Name, type and country are managed in the Team tab.
onboarding.firstFarmDesc: Farms hold your fields, boundaries and observations. This opens the Farms tab — nothing is created here.
onboarding.firstFieldDesc: Fields define the boundaries every model works with. You can draw them in the Farms tab.
onboarding.cropsDesc: Record crop history per field to unlock rotation and planning models.
onboarding.reviewDesc: Your setup so far. Required steps are marked.
onboarding.tourOverview: Overview — the season at a glance
onboarding.tourFarms: Farms & Fields — boundaries, observations and data imports
onboarding.dismissDesc: You can reopen this wizard from the Team tab at any time.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.prefsDesc: Choose which categories reach you. Changes apply immediately.
notifications.emailHint: Email delivery depends on a configured provider; in-app notifications always work.
notifications.prefsSaveError: Could not save the notification preference.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.desc: Presentation settings for your account, saved to your profile.
preferences.languageHint: The interface language is switched with the language control in the header.
